text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"My. There are so many works of art 
outside as well... Every single one is 
lovely."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...? There's just one, way over there in 
that spot.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The title is "Solitude." ...I see, this 
sense of isolation is part of the work 
itself, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...It makes one want to add at least a 
single flower, doesn't it?"
